arguments.content:
import zipfile
out = []
with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    for n in z.namelist():
        out.append(n)
    out.append('---SHEET1---')
    out.append(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8'))
    out.append('---SHEET2---')
    out.append(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml').decode('utf-8'))
    out.append('---SHARED---')
    out.append(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml').decode('utf-8'))
with open('dump.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(out))
print('done')
